name: Bareos Open Source Backup
free_limit: AGPLv3 open-source network backup and recovery with file/database backups, catalog, restore, disk/tape and S3-compatible targets; no software seat or backup-job quota.
watch_out: Operate Bareos director, storage daemons, catalog database, clients and backup media yourself; hosting, object storage and optional vendor subscription/support cost extra. AGPLv3 source-sharing and notice obligations apply when required.
